jcr:content.jcr:title: Hengrove Play Park
jcr:content.jcr:description: A large adventure play park within an open green space in south Bristol.
jcr:content.shortDescription: A large adventure play park within an open green space in south Bristol.

placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Hengrove offers an active outing centred on its adventure play park. The wider park and wheels area make this a place where families may want to plan more than a quick stop.

Our family idea: agree a meeting point before play begins and build in a snack break. Check the current opening information before setting out, especially if a particular play feature is the reason for your visit.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families looking for a substantial playground outing.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Play park, cafe, toilets with baby changing and picnic seating.
placepracticalinfo.parking: There is no dedicated park car park; plan legal local parking or public transport.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: The play park has its own opening hours, separate from the wider park. Check seasonal facilities and access arrangements before visiting.

placevisitmap.heading: Plan your visit
placevisitmap.address: Hengrove Park, Hengrove Way, Bristol, BS14 0HR
placevisitmap.travelNote: There is no dedicated park car park; plan legal local parking or public transport. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
